reviews.author: Rukesh Raj
reviews.text:
I ordered Boneless Butter Chicken through Swiggy, but to my surprise, the dish I received contained several pieces with skin attached. In fact, there seemed to be more skin than actual boneless chicken. This is the first time I have experienced receiving a boneless butter chicken dish with so much skin.
When I contacted the restaurant, they claimed that the cook was new and had made the mistake. They replaced the order and collected the original one. However, the replacement was equally disappointing, as the chicken was undercooked. On raising the issue again, the restaurant responded by saying that they had prepared it very quickly because I had already been waiting for a long time, which is why it wasn't cooked properly.
These explanations are unacceptable. A restaurant should maintain basic food quality and hygiene standards regardless of whether the cook is new or the order is delayed. Such careless service and unprofessional excuses have made this a very disappointing experience.

reviews.author: Gowtham Thangaraj
reviews.text:
Visited for a meal while in Yelahanka.
Pros:
• Taste: The food quality is solid. The Biryani and Shawarma items are tasty and portions are good.
• Parking: Good space to park, unlike many other highway restaurants.

• Service: You might have to wait a while to get the staff's attention. Service speed needs improvement.
• Ambience: It’s a casual place, can get a bit noisy.
Overall, a decent "Dine Spot" if you prioritize taste over premium service.
